Name: Sandy Sprinklers
Author: Bork8008
Description:
[b]Sandy Sprinklers[/b] removes the restriction that prevents sprinklers from being placed on sand tiles in certain areas of the game.
In vanilla Stardew Valley, sand at the Beach, Ginger Island, and Beach Farm visually resembles farmland but does not allow sprinkler placement. This mod relaxes that limitation while leaving normal farm dirt and crop behavior completely unchanged.
Features[list]
[*]Allows sprinklers to be placed on sand
[*]Works at the Beach, Ginger Island, and Beach Farm
[*]Uses normal placement controls (left/right click)
[*]No Harmony required
[*]Multiplayer safe
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
[/list] ﻿Notes This mod only affects beach-style locations. Normal farm dirt, planting rules, and sprinkler behavior elsewhere remain fully vanilla.
